user.title: Zappi schedule
user.description: Pick the myenergi zappi charge mode entity. Its sensors are found automatically; only pick them if setup says it couldn't find them.

data.switch_to_stopped: Switch to Stopped when a scheduled charge starts

data_description.charge_rate: Used to estimate charging slots for Predbat. 7.0 for a single-phase zappi, 22.0 for three-phase.
data_description.control_mode: Zappistant boosts the zappi in your slots, or Intelligent Octopus Go charges and Zappistant only sets Octopus's charge target and ready-by time.
data_description.switch_to_stopped: Zappi control only. Without this the zappi keeps charging in its own mode outside your slots. Octopus control always leaves the zappi in Eco+.

octopus.title: Intelligent Octopus Go
octopus.description: Zappistant sets these Octopus Energy integration entities for each upcoming charge. With a zappi, Octopus can't see the car's battery %, so its charge target is the % of the battery to add: Zappistant works it out from the charge's kWh and the battery size you entered in the Octopus app.

data.octopus_battery_kwh: Battery size in the Octopus app (kWh)

data_description.octopus_battery_kwh: Must match the Octopus app, since Octopus turns the % to add into kWh with it.

error.sensors_not_found: Couldn't find all of the zappi's sensors from the charge mode entity. Pick the missing ones.
